newsitem.title: USA: US stocks mixed at opening.
newsitem.headline: US stocks mixed at opening.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened mixed on Friday, failing to match gains in bonds after second quarter Gross Domestic Product were issued in line with expectations.
The Dow industrials were off two points to 5866. The NASDAQ Index added half a point to 1228.5.
The U.S. economy expanded at a slightly less robust rate in the second quarter than previously thought, the Commerce Department said, though it still surged ahead at the fastest rate in two years.
The country's GDP grew at a 4.7 percent annual rate instead of 4.8 percent in the three months from April through June, the government said in a final revision of second-quarter activity.
